# RecipeCard

A grid tile for a recipe: one fixed square photo with the verdict word as a badge in its corner, an uppercase category eyebrow and a two-line title.

`NomNom.RecipeCard` · Content

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.RecipeCard title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.RecipeCard" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (RecipeCardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `photo` | `string` |  |
| `category` | `string` | Eyebrow, e.g. 'Italian'. @default 'Recipe' |
| `by` | `string` | Owner's short name when it isn't the viewer. |
| `favorite` | `boolean` |  |
| `score` | `number \| null` | 0–100; shown as its verdict word in an elevated reaction Badge on the photo. |
| `verdict` | `string` | Overrides the verdict word. |
